payload.taskDescription: Create CardSprite, CardLayer, and useCardGestures. Render a thumbnail-first texture that upgrades to the display derivative, a pin, a title strip, and a type indicator. Mouse drag starts immediately; touch requires a 500ms long press with a 6px movement tolerance. Taps open the card detail route. Dragging updates the board store at frame rate and persists the final position with a 300ms debounce. Reduced motion removes lift scaling. Mount CardLayer in BoardScene. Do not render strings or selection menus.
